text:
Sam: Heads up — HarborCare (org_id=harborcare-51) shows abrupt token drop: ~80% down over 5 weeks, active seats 28 -> 4. Renewal in ~38 days. Procurement moved to Priya last week and they mentioned a "vendor proofing" exercise. Also heard a short pilot with FluxModels. Need quick triage.

Dylan: Noted. Can we get their recent route & model usage and any deploys or 5xx spikes?

Sam: Org_id=harborcare-51, last_deploy=2024-10-18. Primary route `/batch/predict` using `redwood-gpt-8b-q` with async batching. Tokens/mo 2.8M -> ~520k starting ~2024-10-22.

support-bot: [alert] harborcare-51 1: 79% token decrease over 30d. See: https://redwood/alerts/2850012345 :rotating_light:

Nora: Quick check in logs shows a pattern: their client started sending bigger batches but then switched to a scheduled job that only fires weekly. Also some `DeadlineExceeded` errors from their infra on 2024-10-24.

Dylan: I'll run a quick query.
```sql
SELECT day, tokens, seats, route FROM usage WHERE org='harborcare-51' ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 40;
```

Dylan: Results: daily tokens and seats dropped sharply after 2024-10-22. 5xx rate peaked 10/24 (mostly client timeouts) then normalized. Suggests client-side throttling or cron change.

Sam: Support ticket #80012 opened on 2024-10-25 for `DeadlineExceeded` errors; engineering on their side acknowledged a retry loop that tripled latency and then they disabled the pipeline.

Priya: I joined procurement sync yesterday. We're being cautious 1; procurement wants a short, measurable PoC showing cost delta and reliability. They asked about alternatives like FluxModels and NebulaServe.

Nora: For the PoC, recommend: 2-week dedicated credit window, ingest replay of last 30 days traffic, baseline latency & cost metrics, and an ops handover doc.

Dylan: I'll export model latency percentiles, kv-cache-hit, and request traces. Will also capture per-route token burn to make a cost map.

Sam: Suggested outreach: Priya and their PM (ask for deployment schedule and approval committee). Proposed message: "Priya 1 quick q: can you confirm whether the scheduled job replaced live traffic and who owns the deployment window? We can set a short PoC to replay production load."

support-bot: Ticket #80012 status: awaiting-customer-reply. Link: https://redwood/support/80012

Priya: I'll accept the invite if you propose a short agenda focused on cause, PoC scope, and renewal timeline.

Dylan: Logs & export uploaded: https://redwood/logs/harborcare-51/2850012345-trace (includes tail, kvcache, 5xx breakdown).

Nora: I'll prep the PoC checklist and a 1-slide cost-to-value mapping (tokens -> monthly cost -> projected savings with batching tweaks).

Sam: Owners: Outreach & renewal touch = Priya; Diagnostics & traces = Dylan; Support follow-up & ticket = Nora; PoC collateral = Sam. I'll tag account `renewal:risk-high` and add CRM note w/ action items.

Priya: Please also capture competitor rationale 1 is FluxModels cheaper at scale or offering a feature we lack? I'll surface that in procurement.

Sam: Agreed. Add a short competitive capture: price per 1M tokens, latency SLO, on-prem options. I'll draft a one-pager.

Dylan: Let's do a 20m prep tomorrow 9:30am PT before the discovery call. Nora/Sam to join.

Nora: On it. Will bring the PoC checklist and support timeline.

Sam: Recap actions: (1) Invite & agenda to Priya 1 Priya (2) Traces & diagnostics upload 1 Dylan (3) Support ticket chase 1 Nora (4) PoC slide + comp-capture 1 Sam. Tagging renewal risk and scheduling PoC proposal for next week.

Priya: Thanks team. I'll loop in their PM and legal if PoC is green.

Sam: Will follow up in CRM and update the account playbook. :white_check_mark:
